title: Brain’s Song
description: The tragic tale of Brain Piccadilly, a former arena football player suffering from a bad case of stomach cramps, as told by his longtime friend and teammate, Meadowlark Lemon.
quote: I only hope nothing of tragic proportions befalls me whilst I play my beloved pastime: football.
altHero: Brain Piccadilly, mouse with curly red hair, holding a lemon that looks like a football
alt1: Brain talking with Meadowlark Lemon, a mouse on stilts
